chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: 1944: a package show to New Orleans and teaming with pianist Connie Berry
summary: Dance recalls the package tour south and west in 1944. Humes teamed with Atlanta pianist Connie Berry, who had played two pianos with Joe Turner and for Gladys Bentley. They worked clubs in California, sometimes booked by Joe Glaser.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well listen, you must have spent a good bit of time between those clubs and everything in New York, and then you went over on a package show, do you remember? You went down to New Orleans on a tour and from there is when you started to work your way out to California.
